newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Countdown Outlook.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Countdown Outlook.

text.p: Following is a calendar counting down to the handover of the British colony of Hong Kong to China at midnight on June 30.
JUNE 9
- Dragon Boat Festival. Public Holiday
JUNE 10
- Royal Navy 21 Gun salute to mark Duke of Edinburgh's birthday
JUNE 10-11
Violinist Nigel Kennedy and cellist Julian Lloyd Webber concerts at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre
JUNE 23
- Royal Yacht Britannia arrives in Hong Kong
JUNE 28
- Public Holiday. Queen Elizabeth's Official birthday
Royal Navy to fire 21-gun salute
JUNE 30
- Last day of British colonial rule. Public holiday.
*4.30 (0830 GMT) - Governor Chris Patten due to depart from Government House for Royal Yacht Britannia
*6.15 pm (1015 GMT) - Sunset ceremony by outgoing British administration and military forces. Waterfront, Central district Hong Kong island
*7.30 pm (11.30 GMT) - Cocktail reception for 4,000 guests of honour. Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
*8 pm (noon GMT) - Harbour Fireworks display
*9 pm (1300 GMT) - Banquet for 4,000 guests. Hong Kong Exhibition and Convention Centre

*11.30 pm (1530 GMT) - Handover ceremony begins. British and Hong Kong flags to be lowered ahead of midnight (0800 GMT). Chinese flag and the new Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) flag to be hoisted after midnight.
*Midnight (0800 GMT) - Sovereignty of the British colony of Hong Kong reverts to China.
- China resumes sovereignty of Hong Kong. Public holiday.
* After midnight - Britain's Prince Charles, and Chris Patten, the 28th and last British colonial governor, depart on the Royal Yacht Britannia.
* Commander British Forces Bryan Dutton to depart on floating command ship HMS Chatham. Remaining British forces to leave by air. All scheduled to be out of Hong Kong by 3 am (1900 GMT)

*1.30 am (1730) - China's State Council to inaugurate the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) goverrnment and swear in the Chief Executive, principle officials, judges and provisional legislators. Hong Kong Exhibition and Cultural Centre
*DAWN - People's Liberation Army expected to cross the land border into Hong Kong
*10 am (0200) - The new Hong Kong SAR government to host celebration for about 4,600 guests. Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa to make inaugural speech

*6.30 pm (1030 GMT) Gala performance by local, mainland and international celebrities including kung fu film star Jackie Chan, China's Central Military Band, drum band from Shanxi province. Hong Kong Coliseum.
*8.30 pm (1230 GMT) - Harbour fireworks display
JULY 2
- Public holiday to mark China's resumption of sovereignty.
JULY 3
- FIFA-Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Reunification Cup football match
JULY 4-5
- Hong Kong China Phiharmonic Orchestra celebration concert at City Hall
JULY 5

- Celebrate Hong Kong 1997 rock concert featuring Scottish band Wet Wet Wet, English singer Lisa Stansfield, U.S. rhythm and blues group All-4-One, and Zhou Feng of China. Happy Valley Race Course ========================================================
DECEMBER 1999
- Administration of Portuguese-run Macau reverts to China.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6352
